description: Use this when the user wants to count visitors that AI assistants send to their website. Turns on counting of the people ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, Claude and other assistants send to an app's own website, and their clicks to the App Store or Google Play (tagged with an App Store campaign token per assistant) or a purchase the site reports. Returns the script tag to add to the site; calling it again keeps the same key. Domains default to the ones AI-answer tracking knows, else the project's website. Counts only, no cookies.
name: ai_referrals_setup
title: Count visitors AI assistants send
